revision: S3/P4: jacks IN L, IN R, LINE on top, volume pots VOL L/VOL R, PHONES jack at the bottom; IN R normalled to IN L; unshrouded 2x5 pin header J5 (10-pin cable). R3 routed
frame: Panel frame: origin at the panel upper-left corner seen from the front, X across (right), Y down, mm. KiCad sheet position = kicad_origin + panel XY. The main PCB F side faces the panel, so the KiCad top view equals the front view (no mirroring).
rail_note: Doepfer 4HP single hole pair at X7.5 (HOLE_X0 in case/tools/build_case.py). The repository skiff rails are 10 mm wide centred on Y3.0/Y125.5, leaving the clear Y8.0..120.5 (112.5 mm) gap; commercial rails differ, so the PCB keeps 1.25 mm margin and the 10-pin IDC socket envelope on J5 stays on the board, inside the gap.

main_pcb.note: 19.0 x 110.0 mm (Doepfer parallel-PCB maximum), 1.25 mm inside the skiff rail gap at each end; held only by the four jack bushings/nuts (the pots are soldered; their nuts are optional, docs/mechanics.md).

column_note: Jacks and pots share one centred column at X10.0 (the panel centre line). Top to bottom: IN L, IN R, LINE, VOL L, VOL R, PHONES.
jack_rotation_note: As modules/midi: T/TN(R)/S pads run along X with the S (sleeve) pad toward the left board edge (T at X+4.92, TN/R at X-3.38, S at X-6.48); jack bodies are 9.0 mm along Y.
pot_note: Bread Modular Potentiometer_RV09 footprint; its origin is offset (+0.127, +0.508) from the shaft centre. Placed by shaft centre, rotation 0: mounting tabs at shaft Y, pins 1-2-3 (GND, wiper, CW end) 7.5 mm below the shaft at X-2.5/0/+2.5. PHONES (J4) sits as high as the RV2 courtyard allows (J4 F courtyard Y90.71 vs RV2 Y90.69) so a 10-pin IDC socket on J5 below it clears the J4 B-side pads (J4 pad bottom Y97.3, socket envelope top Y99.73); the pots keep the 19 mm pitch.
panel_hole_note: Pot hole 7.2 mm = Bread Modular PanelHole_Potentiometer_RV09. The user's pot has no threaded bushing (plain Ø6 knurled shaft), so the hole is shaft clearance only.

stack_Z_mm.datum: Z0 = main PCB F.Cu surface, +Z toward the panel
stack_Z_mm.source: Jacks: slices of the Bread Modular AudioJacks STEP models (PJ301M-12.step, PJ366ST.step); the library marks them 'Untested', so measure real jacks. Pot: user sample (2026-10-19 photo, B1M RV09 'tall trimmer' style): no threaded bushing, 16 mm knurled shaft above the body (user measurement); body height nominal.
stack_Z_mm.pot_note: RV09 proxy (tools/make_pot_model.py): body 6.8 mm (nominal), 1 mm collar, shaft to Z22.8 = 11.2 mm past the FR4 front (10.8 mm past the printed front) for a push-on knob. No bushing, so no pot nut: the carrier hangs on the four jack nuts only (as before).

power_header.orientation: Vertical (pin rows along Y). Pin 1/2 (-12 V) at the bottom row Y113.7, pins 9/10 (+12 V) at the top row Y103.54.
power_header.idc_note: Unshrouded 2x5 pin header (the user's part: bare 2.54 mm pins, no box), same pads as the earlier keyed box header, so copper is unchanged. Plug a 10-pin IDC socket with the red stripe (-12 V, pin 1) at the bottom; there is no key, so check the stripe. Envelope = 2x5 IDC socket (12.7 x 6.4 mm body + ~1.2 mm key bump), 3.81 mm beyond the end pin centres, X as MIDI: bottom Y117.51 stays on the board (Y119.25) and inside the rail clear gap (Y120.5); top Y99.73 is 2.4 mm below the J4 B-side pads (Y97.3). A 16-pin socket aligned at pin 1 would reach Y92.11 and sit over the J4 (PHONES) leads, so use a 10-to-16 cable on a 16-pin bus; the board is not changed for 16-pin plugs (user, 2026-10-19). D1/C3 and D2/C4 stand vertically in the strips beside the header, outside the socket envelope.
